description: Latest Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663) stock-token spread snapshot for 12 tokenized US stocks and ETFs (NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL, AMD, COIN, PLTR, SPY, QQQ): on-chain Uniswap v3 pool price with a v4 cross-check price, pool liquidity in USD, and the percentage spread of the token price versus the US-listed reference quote, sampled every 5 minutes. Only derived fields are returned; the reference quote itself is not included. Sampling continues while US markets are closed. The response reports the sample timestamp, data age in seconds and a stale flag. Each symbol entry also includes trailing-24-hour spread statistics (min, max, average and sample count). For monitoring and research, not an execution feed.
name: rh-stock-spreads
